test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_union_disjoint_{n} (id UInt64, p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_union_disjoint_{n} SELECT number, [[ (3. * number, 0.), (3. * number, 1.), (3. * number + 1., 1.), (3. * number + 1., 0.), (3. * number, 0.)]] FROM numbers({n})
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonUnion(p) FROM bench_union_disjoint_{n} FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT groupPolygonUnionMerge(s) FROM (SELECT groupPolygonUnionState(p) AS s FROM bench_union_disjoint_{n} GROUP BY intDiv(id, 32)) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
